readings.Aries: There's someone around you who has been trying to get a word in. Let them. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Taurus: Your relationship with pleasure is complicated in a way that has nothing to do with pleasure. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Gemini: You narrate your life in real time. Today, stop narrating and just live the scene. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Cancer: The mood that arrived without explanation is responding to something real. What is it? What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Leo: The stage you've been avoiding is smaller than you imagine, and the audience is ready. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Virgo: The critique you've been preparing is accurate. Decide whether delivering it will improve anything. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Libra: You've been seeing both sides so long you've forgotten which one you were on originally. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Scorpio: What you love, you love completely, and you never fully stop. This is a fact of your chemistry. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Sagittarius: There is a pattern in the places you leave and why. Worth examining before the next departure. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Capricorn: There is a risk worth taking that your caution has been routing around. Take it. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Aquarius: The future you see is real. The path there runs through the present, which is inconvenient. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Pisces: There is beauty in what's in front of you that you've been too inside it to see. Step back. The energy available today is better used gently.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
